title: Potatoes Grows Big with Straw Mulch Method To Save Effort Likely to Be Viral Next Spring 2023 Season
reason: Provides instructions for growing potatoes with minimal effort.

tasks.task: Explain the potato planting method to achieve a large crop with little effort.

subtasks.text: Dig shallow holes for potato planting and place one potato at a distance of 15cm.
Spread soil to cover the seedlings slightly and place a thick layer of straw on top.
Water the area abundantly to ensure the straw remains wet and supports potato growth.

tasks.task: Detail the expected outcome of this potato planting method.

subtasks.text: Expect large and clean potatoes as a result of this method.
